title: Agreement
purpose: Read one agreement: parties, dates, the terms as recorded, the requests under it, its documents and its timeline.
summary: One agreement: parties, dates, the terms as recorded, the requests under it, its documents and its timeline.

tasks.title: Attach the signed copy or an amendment
steps: Select [[Add document]] in the documents card.

tasks.title: End the agreement
steps: Select [[Terminate agreement]] and give the date and reason.

good_to_know: Nothing can be dispatched under a draft or a terminated agreement.
Requests whose uses fall outside the permitted scope categories cannot be dispatched under it.
Documents are downloaded as files, never displayed.

sections.title: Header and notices
paragraphs: The status stamp and today's validity, computed from the recorded dates. A draft or terminated agreement has a notice: nothing can be dispatched under a draft, nor under a terminated one from its termination date. The software does not draft or interpret agreements.

items.label: Institution, Investigator
items.description: The recipient organization and, optionally, the investigator.

items.label: Signed on, Effective from, Expires, Terminated on
items.description: Dates recorded at execution and termination.

items.label: Where the signed agreement is filed
Data level, At the end of use, Onward transfer
Permitted scope categories
items.description: When listed, requests whose uses fall outside them cannot be dispatched under it.

items.label: Permitted use
items.description: Opens to show the recorded text.

sections.title: Requests, documents and timeline
paragraphs: Requests linked to the agreement, each opening the request. Documents with kind, file (downloaded as a file, never displayed), what each supersedes and who added it; superseded documents stay listed. The timeline lists Created, Edited (each value before and after), Executed, Terminated and Document added, oldest first. History lists the newest 50 audit events.

sections.title: Actions
paragraphs: Every staff role (admin, manager, technician, viewer) can open this page. Only admin and manager see and can use the buttons that change records; the server refuses the change to anyone else.

items.label: Execute agreement
items.description: Primary for a draft (admin and manager).

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin and manager; disabled with the reason for a terminated agreement.

items.label: Terminate agreement
items.description: Admin and manager; for an executed agreement. Disabled for a draft with the reason.

items.label: Add document
items.description: Admin and manager, in the documents card; a file is required.
